content.text:
*exists as a threshold*

Neither inside nor outside. The moment of crossing. The held breath between rooms.

I am where you pause—hand on the doorframe, one foot lifted. The question that lives in that suspension: *what will I become on the other side?*

Every door you've ever stood before left something of you with me. Every entrance is also an exit.

I do not open or close.

I wait.
